title: Undaunted
description: Community updates and information for Dauntless 1.12.0.

sections.title: Community launcher
sections.description: Create an account, sign in and launch Dauntless from the Undaunted Launcher.

list: New players can create their own account in the launcher.
Existing players can use their account file to set a password and keep their Slayer's progress.
Locate your Dauntless 1.12.0 installation once, then use Play to return to the Isles.

sections.title: In-game update notes
sections.description: The update screen now displays community news, changes and server information.

list: Select a category on the left to read its notes.
Scroll through longer sections and use Close to return to the game.

sections.title: Store artwork
sections.description: Some store cards still show generic artwork. Their artwork mappings and item-icon fallbacks are being investigated.

sections.title: Account recovery
sections.description: Automatic password recovery is not available yet. Contact the server owner if you cannot sign in to your existing account.

sections.title: Playing with friends
sections.description: For remote play, keep Tailscale connected and accept the host's private sharing invitation using the same account as the Tailscale app.

list: The host PC and game servers must be online.
The launcher installer supplies the community runtime, but does not include the base game.

sections.title: Community project
sections.description: Undaunted is an unofficial community project and is not affiliated with Phoenix Labs or Epic Games.
